$description: Interaction pattern templates for the 22 Tier 1 Synapse components. The remaining 24 components inherit from the root spec baseline.

behaviors: Expand/collapse panels on header activation
Only one panel open at a time by default (multi-expand configurable)
Collapsed panels are hidden from accessibility tree

keyboard.ArrowUp: Move focus to previous accordion header
keyboard.ArrowDown: Move focus to next accordion header
keyboard.Home: Move focus to first accordion header
keyboard.End: Move focus to last accordion header

behaviors: Triggers action on click
Shows loading state when async operation in progress
Disabled state prevents interaction and removes from tab order

root.aria-disabled: true when disabled (prefer over HTML disabled for focusability)

behaviors: Toggles between checked and unchecked states
Supports indeterminate (mixed) state for partial group selection
Group selection: parent checkbox reflects aggregate child state
Renders as modal overlay on top of page content
Focus trap: Tab/Shift+Tab cycles focus within dialog boundary
Closes on Escape key press
Returns focus to the trigger element on close
Blocks interaction with background content

keyboard.Tab: Move focus to next focusable element within dialog
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Move focus to previous focusable element within dialog

root.aria-labelledby: ID of the dialog title element
root.aria-describedby: ID of the dialog content/description element

behaviors: Opens dropdown listbox on click or Enter
Highlights option on arrow key navigation
Selects highlighted option on Enter
Type-ahead filters or jumps to matching options
Closes on Escape or outside click

keyboard.ArrowDown: Open listbox (when closed) or move to next option (when open)
keyboard.Enter: Select the highlighted option and close
keyboard.Type-ahead: Jump to option matching typed characters

trigger.aria-activedescendant: ID of the currently highlighted option

behaviors: Horizontal tab navigation between tab elements
Activates associated panel on tab selection
Supports automatic activation (focus = select) or manual activation (Enter to select)
Auto-dismiss after configurable duration (default 5s)
Pause dismiss timer on hover or focus
Manual dismiss via close button
Multiple toasts stack vertically
Content announced to screen readers on appearance

keyboard.Tab: Move focus to the close button

behaviors: Appears on hover (mouse) after ~200ms delay
Appears on focus (keyboard) without delay
Disappears on mouse leave or blur
Contains no interactive content (text only)

keyboard.Escape: Dismiss the tooltip when trigger is focused

behaviors: Accepts text input from user
Shows placeholder text when empty
Supports validation with error state styling and message
Clear button appears when input has content
Supports prefix and suffix icon slots

root.aria-describedby: ID of helper text or error message element

behaviors: Toggles between on and off (binary state)
Triggers immediate action (no form submit required)
Visually distinct from checkbox to signal immediate effect
Single selection within a group of options
Arrow keys move selection between radio buttons
Selection wraps from last to first and vice versa

keyboard.Tab: Enter or leave the radio group (does not move between radios)

behaviors: Drag thumb or use arrow keys to change value
Respects min, max, and step constraints
Displays current value visually
Supports range mode with two thumbs

thumb.aria-labelledby: ID of the associated label (alternative to aria-label)

behaviors: Shows current page location within a hierarchy
Last item represents the current page and is not a link
Visual separator rendered between items
Navigate between pages of paginated content
Displays current page indicator
Previous/Next buttons for sequential navigation
Optional direct page number input

keyboard.Enter: Navigate to the focused page or activate prev/next

prevNext.aria-disabled: true when at first/last page boundary

behaviors: Sortable columns via header click
Row selection via click
Column resize via drag on header border

keyboard.Enter: Sort column when header is focused

behaviors: Virtualized row rendering for large datasets
Sortable and filterable columns
Editable cells with inline editing
Row selection (single or multi-select)
Column reordering via drag

keyboard.Enter: Enter edit mode on focused cell

behaviors: Multi-step linear flow with numbered step indicators
Shows current, completed, and upcoming step states
Allows navigation back to completed steps
Blocks forward navigation until current step is valid
Modal dialog containing a multi-step flow
Back/Next button navigation between steps
Step validation required before proceeding forward
Final step replaces Next with Submit action
Focus trap within modal (same as dialog pattern)
Escape to close with confirmation if form has unsaved changes

keyboard.Tab: Move focus between form elements and navigation buttons
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Move focus to previous focusable element within modal

behaviors: Text input with search icon
Shows suggestions dropdown as user types
Debounced API calls to reduce request frequency
Clear button to reset input
Loading state displayed during async result fetch

keyboard.Enter: Select highlighted suggestion or submit search query

input.aria-activedescendant: ID of the currently highlighted suggestion

behaviors: Displays a label with optional dismiss (remove) action
Click dismiss button to remove the tag
Variant colors indicate different categories or states

keyboard.Tab: Move focus to the tag or its dismiss button

behaviors: Renders background dimming layer behind modal content
Click overlay to dismiss (optional, configurable)
Prevents background page scroll while active

keyboard.Escape: Close the overlay and associated content

background.aria-hidden: true on all background content behind overlay

behaviors: Navigates to URL on click
External links open in a new tab
Visited state styling for previously visited links

root.aria-label: Includes 'opens in new tab' for external links
